resources.string: Another app may be using the radio\'s serial port, most likely the stock RadioMaster app. Tap Close stock app, or swipe it away in the recent-apps view, or use Settings, Apps, RadioMaster AX, Force stop. Then tap Retry. Only one app can talk to the radio at a time.
Another app may be using the radio\'s serial port. Close any other app that talks to the radio, then tap Retry. Only one app can talk to the radio at a time.
Still connecting. The stock RadioMaster app may still be running in the background and blocking the radio.
The radio library could not be loaded. Set the radio backend to Simulator in the system settings to try the app without a radio.
The radio firmware is not compatible with this app. Firmware updates are done in the stock RadioMaster app.
You can continue without the radio to open the model library, the settings and the help; nothing can be sent to the radio until the connection works.
open-ax12 is an open app for the RadioMaster AX12 that keeps the stock look and adds EdgeTX-style functions such as logical switches, special functions, flight modes and voice.
The stock RadioMaster app and open-ax12 cannot use the radio at the same time. Only one of them can be connected.
The connection to the radio is being set up in the background.
Always close the stock RadioMaster app
Closes it before connecting so that it cannot block the radio
Start open-ax12 when the radio boots
Opens this app a few seconds after the radio has started
You can change both choices later in System, App.
Shown while the app keeps the radio connection, voice and logging running.
The receiver is connected. Saving changes what the radio sends to the aircraft right away. Write the settings now?
Save or discard the changes first, then open the file again
